name: Aussie Gamers MC
description:
G'day, mate! Come build with us.

Aussie Gamers MC is a cozy, community-run network hosted in Sydney, so Aussie and Kiwi players get proper low ping. Jump in from your phone, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch or PC. Bedrock and Java players share the same worlds.

OPEN NOW

• Survival: settle in, claim your patch, build something you're proud of

ON THE WAY

• Skyblock, Bedwars, Creative and Prison

WHY STICK AROUND

• Sydney-hosted, low ping for Australia and NZ

• Bedrock + Java crossplay

• A friendly crew. We're here to hang out, not grind you down

• No pay-to-win: supporter ranks are cosmetic only

HOW TO JOIN (BEDROCK)

Servers → Add Server

Address: play.aussiegamers.com.au

Port: 19132

Please use the address above, not a numeric IP.

Voting? Type your name exactly as it shows in game, dot included (e.g. .YourName).

Discord: https://aussiegamers.au/discord

Website: https://aussiegamers.com.au

Your new home server. Come say g'day!
